thread:
maya: Quick sync: plan a cautious v2 slowpush on split-route tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Scope: us-west + us-east, start at 10% -> 25% if green. Monitor: p50/p95, 4xx/5xx, client-parse errors.
trent: noted. Which signals will route to v2? header X-API-Version=2, fallback query client_ver=v2. Anything else?
maya: also respect client-preference cookie if present. Default no-signal -> v1.
qa: preflight checklist posted: compatibility probe, canary dashboard, rollback playbook, auto-pin enabled. Ran probe: us-east missing header ~0.7%, mobile ~1.1%.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: split-route -> v2 at 1761196800. Canary windows: 15m stages. Will emit snapshots at +3m, +8m, +15m. Auto-pin heuristic ON (threshold=45% 5xx over 120s).
trent: ops note: mobile proxies sometimes strip cookies; prefer header-based guidance in release notes.
maya: release notes draft: add pin command and auto-pin behavior.
(After start)
devops-bot: Canary +3m: p50 +10ms, p95 +80ms, 5xx=3. No auto-pins.
qa: enabling structured-logs at 1% to capture failures.
(8m)
devops-bot: Canary +8m: p95 slightly up, 5xx=9 clustered to tenant-991.
deploy-bot: Auto-pin tenant-991 -> pinned to v1 at 1761197438. Reason: sustained 5xx >45%.
trent: sample from structured logs shows client sent trailing commas in events array; v2 strict parser rejects.
maya: ops, confirm no proxy 502 spike?
trent: none. Root-cause client payload. Support notified tenant-991.
qa: created regression test ticket RG-2021 to catch trailing commas.
maya: decision: continue slowpush to 25% after patching docs and adding tolerant parser flag behind runtime toggle. Ramp delayed 1 day to allow client outreach.
deploy-bot: Rollback snippet available: `deploy-bot rollback --route split-route --to-version v1` and `infractl remove-canary split-route`.
maya: thank you. Will update release board: hold for 24h and add tenant example to notes.
(After 24h)
maya: follow-up: clients patched, regression test in CI, reschedule ramp. Closing thread.
